description: When pushing the xAI/Cole Estrate meeting prep PDF to reMarkable, a new folder 'Improving | Meeting Prep' was created instead of using the existing 'Meetings' folder. Fabricated a folder structure rather than checking where meeting prep documents actually live on the device.
